Hi Jared —

Thanks again for agreeing to co-sell on this listing. AWS asked for a single consolidated evidence packet to accelerate CPPO acceptance; they called out partner IDs, signed reseller agreement, sample POs, and a short list of customer reference / pilot notes. Can you send the following by EOD Wednesday (PST)?

Jared, one ask on the evidence packet: can you include a short diagram (PNG) showing who issues invoices to the end customer and which entity invoices for AWS Marketplace-eligible SKUs? AWS frequently asks for a simple flow diagram and that speeds approvals.

I'll be the exec sponsor for any billing exceptions; happy to jump on a 20-min call if the flows are messy.
